title: Seized Money Can't Be Retained After Acquittal: Rajasthan High Court Orders Release Of ₹7.35 Lakh In Gambling Case, Seeks I-T Verification
description: The Rajasthan High Court�has held that once a party stands acquitted in a gambling case, based on withdrawal of the criminal case, there is no reason to retain the seized money in the Treasury or in the Government Fund. The bench of Justice Anoop Kumar Dhand�thus directed the authorities to release the amount seized from the petitioner, subject to the condition that the petitioner shall disclose the details of the source of receipt of the amount.
